commands.review_summary:
The branch moves daily and `/stream` cache misses into `DomainDO`, coalesces generation, hardens stream/fallback storage, separates provider and Gateway credentials, and updates docs, tests, changelog text, and ignore rules.

Reproducibility: yes. source inspection gives a high-confidence path: current main asks the Durable Object for an existing record, then falls through to Worker-side `streamGenerate` on a miss despite the documented one-generation-per-host/day invariant. I did not run live Wrangler in this read-only review.

target.title: [codex] Coalesce daily generation in Durable Object
target.body:
## Summary

- make the per-host Durable Object the sole owner of daily AI generation
- coalesce concurrent `/daily` and `/stream` misses behind one in-flight promise
- detach live stream delivery from canonical generation so an unread or disconnected client cannot block storage or peers
- keep live streams `no-store` until a complete canonical record is stored
- treat malformed, truncated, timed-out, or disconnected upstream streams as failures and persist deterministic fallback text
- keep Durable Object storage bounded to the newest record, including across UTC-midnight races and legacy-key migration
- keep the xAI provider key in `Authorization` and send authenticated Gateway credentials separately in `cf-aig-authorization`
- route the public xAI model identifier through Cloudflare's required `grok/` namespace when using its unified `/compat` endpoint
- update regression tests, documentation, and the changelog; preserve contributor credit

## Why

Cloudflare edge cache entries are data-center local, so they cannot enforce the project's one-generation-per-host-per-UTC-day invariant. The Durable Object now owns that invariant. A first `/stream` request can still stream live output, while concurrent requests wait on the same generation and receive only the stored complete record.

The repair also closes operational failure modes in the original patch: caching a stream clone before completion, ending the timeout after response headers, accepting SSE without `[DONE]`, caching a Worker-local fallback that could diverge from Durable Object state, an unread stream blocking canonical storage, a prior-day completion overwriting a newer record, and unbounded date-key storage growth.

## Validation

- `pnpm check` — typecheck, lint, format, and 21 tests
- `pnpm dlx wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run` — Wrangler 4.106.0; exact HEAD bundle SHA-256 `3696408c30b86ed29a5256844b8ab14e7c9480367558ffa774cd06dc5febbddf`
- [exact-head GitHub CI](https://github.com/steipete/lore.md/actions/runs/28573617616) — build and GitGuardian checks passed at `eba7e51faea6636ed19eae0c77dff7cc704daa8d`
- source-blind behavior validation against the exact built Worker:
  - five concurrent cold requests produced one upstream call and identical responses
  - live `/stream` plus `/daily` produced one upstream call and byte-identical canonical output
  - a truncated SSE stream exposed interruption to that client, stored deterministic fallback, and excluded partial output
  - an entirely unread live stream did not block canonical storage or a concurrent daily response
  - provider and Gateway authorization headers were independently validated
- authenticated xAI proof against the candidate runtime:
  - five concurrent cold requests produced one provider call, 200 responses, and identical output
  - live `/stream` plus `/daily` produced one provider call, matching canonical text, and `no-store` on the live stream
  - an invalid provider credential was rejected and deterministic fallback became the stored record
- authenticated Cloudflare AI Gateway proof against the exact candidate:
  - invalid Gateway authentication was rejected with 401
  - non-streaming and streaming provider calls returned 200 through `/compat`; streaming completed with `[DONE]`
  - three concurrent cold Worker requests returned identical output, a repeat reused the record, and `/stream` plus `/daily` returned matching visible text with the intended cache headers
- final whole-branch `$autoreview`: no actionable findings, patch correct (0.86 confidence)
- Public Model Identifier Gate: PASS — `grok-4-1-fast-reasoning` is an official xAI alias; xAI documents its redirect behavior in the [May 15 retirement notice](https://docs.x.ai/developers/migration/may-15-retirement)

## Merge gate

Authenticated xAI provider and authenticated AI Gateway proof pass. The one-active-slot per-version storage contract preserves same-day legacy records, bounds future growth, and does not alter or bulk-delete older stored keys. Exact-head CI is green and the PR is mergeable.
